The most defensible synthesis is that NVDA sentiment is elevated but unstable — slow money refuses to sell, fast money is buying puts into an imminent earnings event, and the dominant narrative has shifted from "AI is the future" to "everyone knows it's a bubble, so why isn't anyone selling?" Quantum is not a near-term NVDA threat, but it is a narrative-momentum competitor for the same marginal risk dollar.
